what_differs: WAGR-28 (Requirements, Phase 1, Must Have, unassigned, a stated dependency of WAGR-5) plans Salesforce matching and duplicate rules across three emails, including E-Transfer, plus automatic cross-linking. On 08-18 the team agreed that the CMS sends the primary and secondary emails and that Salesforce does no deduplication. On 08-25 the team agreed on one player per email, with a duplicate rule only on the manual-create path. The per-record-type unique email key is already built under other work (WAGR-92 context), and WAGR-163 retired E-Transfer Email.
suggested_action: Re-scope WAGR-28 to what is still needed (the duplicate check on manual player creation, and whether cross-links are automatic or manual), or close it and link WAGR-92, WAGR-405 and WAGR-40. Remove E-Transfer Email from its scope.
